observations: Black car battery sitting inside a cardboard box.
Label clearly displays 'Everstart' brand and 'CMF55066' model number.
'MADE IN KOREA' is printed on the label and embossed on the plastic casing.
Red and black protective caps are on the terminals.
The 'Fitting Date' grid on the label is unmarked.
A circular state-of-charge indicator (magic eye) is visible on the top left.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a sealed maintenance-free design, but the specific 'Calcium' chemistry text is not legible.

risks.risk: Battery may be discharged or have high internal resistance (dead cells).
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading the voltage and a load test result.

risks.risk: Battery may be old stock; lead-acid batteries degrade even when unused.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturing date code heat-stamped into the plastic casing.

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage such as side-wall bulging or leaks.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides and the bottom of the battery out of the box.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturing date code stamped on the plastic casing.
Video showing a multimeter reading the current voltage.
Photos of the battery from all sides, out of the box.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the label in photo 0. The item can be priced at its worst-case value (scrap/used) until health and age are proven.
